name: Floynk for WooCommerce
author: Floynk

sections.description:
Floynk for WooCommerce is an official free plugin from Floynk for Dutch and Belgian merchants who sell on Bol.com through WooCommerce.

Everything you need to run the repricer lives in wp-admin: connect your store, add Bol.com seller accounts, configure hunt rules, and control prices per product. You work in WordPress — not in a separate Floynk web app.

The plugin is fully functional on its own. Install it, open Floynk in the admin menu, and follow the setup wizard. No trialware, no locked features, no paid tier required to use what you see in the plugin.

What this plugin does

  • Bol.com repricer for WooCommerce products — set min/max prices, activate offers, hunt competitor prices, and restore pricing from the product edit screen
  • Bol.com account wizard in wp-admin — add, verify, list, and remove seller accounts without leaving WordPress
  • Repricer settings — global hunt behavior, timing, price rounding, and default min/max formulas
  • Optional product fields for purchase price, shipping cost, EAN, and brand (enable in settings if you do not already have them elsewhere)
  • Onboarding wizard for first-time setup inside wp-admin
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • WordPress multisite support

Scope

This release is built around Bol.com repricing and Bol.com account management. It does not handle WooCommerce checkout, payments, or basic order processing — that stays in WooCommerce and your existing order tools.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services. By using this plugin you agree to the terms and privacy policies of these services.

Floynk API (https://app.floynk.com)

  • What it is: Hosted repricing and Bol.com account services operated by Floynk B.V., used when you connect the plugin and manage repricers from wp-admin.
  • When data is sent: When you connect your store, save settings, update min/max prices, run a hunt, or manage Bol.com accounts — typically when you use Floynk screens in wp-admin or when repricing runs for active products.
  • What data is sent:
    • Connection credentials for your store (as an Authorization header)
    • WordPress site URL and name
    • WooCommerce product data needed for repricing (for example SKU, EAN, name, price, stock)
    • Repricer settings and price bounds you configure in the plugin
    • Plugin, WordPress, PHP, and WooCommerce versions (for compatibility)
  • Terms of Use: https://www.floynk.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.floynk.com/privacy

Bol.com (https://www.bol.com) — indirect, via Floynk

The plugin does not call Bol.com directly. When you connect a seller account in the Bol.com wizard, credentials are sent over HTTPS to the Floynk API and used server-side for offer management and repricing.

  • Bol.com API documentation: https://developers.bol.com/
  • Bol.com Terms of Use for Partners: https://partnerplatform.bol.com/

Privacy

This plugin does not set cookies on your storefront, does not track site visitors, and does not load third-party scripts on the public site. Admin requests related to repricing and Bol.com accounts go to the Floynk API after you connect the plugin.

Source code

Source for this plugin is maintained at https://github.com/digitxbv/floynk-wordpress-plugin-free. The copy on WordPress.org is the distribution users install from the plugin directory.
sections.installation:
1. Install WooCommerce 7.0 or higher.
  2. Install Floynk for WooCommerce from the WordPress.org plugin directory (or upload the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin).
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Floynk in the wp-admin menu and complete the setup wizard (store connection, Bol.com accounts, repricer settings).
  5. Open the Bol.com tab if you need to add or verify seller accounts.
  6. Edit a WooCommerce product that has an EAN — use the Floynk Repricer metabox to activate repricing, set min/max prices, and run a price hunt.
sections.faq:
Do I need to use the Floynk website to run this plugin?

No. Setup and day-to-day repricer work happen in wp-admin. Use the Floynk menu, settings, Bol.com wizard, and per-product metabox — that is the product.

Do I need a separate dashboard?

No. The plugin is standalone: you configure Bol.com accounts, repricer rules, and product-level pricing from WordPress.

Where are my Bol.com credentials stored?

Bol.com API credentials are sent over HTTPS when you connect an account in the Bol.com wizard and are stored on Floynk infrastructure used for repricing — not in your WordPress database as plain client secrets.

Does the plugin phone home?

The plugin communicates with the Floynk API (https://app.floynk.com) for repricing, Bol.com account management, and settings — only after you install the plugin and connect your store. It does not send anonymous telemetry, open-rate pixels, or tracking beacons. See External services below.

Does this plugin handle my orders?

No. It focuses on Bol.com repricing and seller account setup. WooCommerce continues to handle orders, checkout, and payments. The plugin does not take over basic order processing.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your WooCommerce store keeps working normally. Repricing stops. Bol.com account data held for the service is not deleted automatically when you deactivate — remove accounts in the plugin or contact Floynk support if you want data removed.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Floynk processes data related to repricing and marketplace accounts on your behalf when the plugin is connected. Review Floynk’s Privacy Policy. You remain the data controller for your WooCommerce store.

I’m a Floynk developer. How do I point the plugin at a dev backend?

Add define('FLOYNK_ENVIRONMENT', 'development'); and optionally define('FLOYNK_API_URL', 'http://localhost:8000/api'); to your wp-config.php. By default the plugin uses the production Floynk API.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed: restore load_plugin_textdomain() so bundled Dutch (nl_NL) translations load at runtime.
  • Added bin/wporg-import-dutch-translations.sh helper for manual GlotPress import.

1.0.2

  • Updated plugin directory listing copy (description, FAQ, installation).
  • Ship Dutch (nl_NL) translations in the plugin package.
  • Added production banners and icons on wordpress.org.

1.0.1

  • Scope: the WordPress.org release is focused on the Bol.com repricer and Bol.com account management.
  • Removed account-level gating from the plugin. Every feature in the plugin is shown to every user unconditionally.
  • Fixed: inline admin JavaScript and CSS blocks are now enqueued via wp_enqueue_script() / wp_enqueue_style() with the script data passed through wp_localize_script() per the WordPress developer guidelines.
  • Fixed: removed explicit translation loading; WordPress.org loads plugin translations automatically on supported WordPress versions.
  • Fixed: updated the Terms and Privacy Policy URLs in readme.txt to point at live pages.
  • Removed: the optional self-hosted update checker code path. The plugin now ships exclusively through WordPress.org.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Connect WooCommerce to Floynk with a single API key.
  • Bol.com connection wizard for configuring marketplace accounts.
  • Per-product repricer settings with min/max prices and hunt/restore controls.
  • Repricer configuration tab with hunt behavior, timing, rounding, and default price formulas.
  • Optional custom product fields (purchase price, shipping cost, EAN, brand).
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility.
  • WordPress multisite support.
